com_scope_precedence: Higher priority wins: by default users (100) override groups (20), which override roles (10), which override Base.
com_scope_precedence_ordered: Base applies first. Then higher priority wins: by default users (100) override groups (20), which override roles (10). On equal priority, users win over groups and groups over roles.
com_scope_priority_help: Higher priority wins. By default users (100) override groups (20), groups override roles (10), and every profile overrides Base.
com_scope_priority_help_ordered: Base applies first, whatever its priority. Profiles then apply from lowest to highest priority, so higher priority wins; on equal priority, roles apply before groups and groups before users. By default users (100) override groups (20), which override roles (10).
com_scope_skip_base_scope: applies to everyone, so it can only be set in the Base configuration
com_scope_skip_inherited_value: set in Base; a profile can only remove its own override
com_scope_skip_inherited_merged: LibreChat merges this Base value back in; it can't be removed in a profile

com_scope_tie_order_wins_other: Same priority as {{names}}, and both change {{count}} settings. For users in both, this profile applies last, so its values win.
